record.body:
## Rationale

basedpyright checks the body of unannotated functions; mypy skips them by default, and much of this code is lightly annotated. It supports a committed baseline, so the job can block before the backlog is gone. It is the Pylance engine, so the editor shows what CI shows. It installs from PyPI with Node bundled and runs from the `dev` group with `uv run`, so it sees the project dependencies. `standard` mode keeps noise low: the default `recommended` mode reports over 4000 warnings (`reportAny`, `reportUnknown*`). The change lives in `mypy-gate`, not `ci-workflow`, so no verified requirement reopens. The user chose this.

## Counter-argument

mypy is the reference checker for typing PEPs and the de facto default, and the `strict-mypy-gate` idea already names it. It reports fewer errors over the three packages today (81 against 101). Pyright and mypy disagree on some inference, so contributors who run mypy locally see different results than CI.

payload.choice: basedpyright standard mode, pinned in the dev group, run with uv run
